props.title: Nested Package
props.description: One parent store; the same child package embedded at two different base paths, plus a standalone instance with its own store.
props.technicalDescription:
Parent spec
CaseContainer → GridRow(cols 2) → [top embedded, bottom embedded, detail, standalone]
State
{ top: { customer: {...} }, bottom: { customer: {...} }, detail: null }
How it works
• createStoreView(store, base) — the child package reads/writes its subtree of the parent store as if it were its own root; no data copies
• EmbeddedChild — boundary component: view + parent.* bridge + nested <Renderer>
• Child writes (notes field) land directly in the parent store at the occurrence's base path
• "Load details" fires parent.loadDetail with { id: { $state: "/id" } } — params resolved in the child's world, handler executed with the parent's accessors
• Standalone — own store, same spec/registry; parent.loadDetail implemented locally
